title: DEPI - Vision
text: Vision To achieve local and regional leadership in the Information and Communications Technology sector by building a highly skilled and innovative Egyptian workforce capable of driving comprehensive digital transformation and creating a sustainable technological future.

title: DEPI - Mission
text: Mission Building and qualifying Egyptian youth to enhance their ability to compete globally through an integrated program to qualify for freelance work and acquire the digital skills required in the contemporary labor market.

title: DEPI - Objectives
text: Objectives Develop technological skills in modern technologies for students and graduates, especially software development, artificial intelligence, data science, business analytics, Digital Game Creation and digital arts, among others. Providing a suitable environment for students and graduates to start their own businesses on freelance platforms. Qualifying students and graduates to join distinctive jobs in the field of ICT.

title: DEPI - Scholarship Benefits
text: Program Overview & Objectives To empower students and graduates and equip them to meet the rapidly evolving demands of the labor market through integrated training programs and specialized workshops delivered in collaboration with leading international and local technology companies, bridging the skills gap in emerging technology domains and AI applications across various professional sectors. Objectives Human Capital Development: Preparing a generation of youth and graduates capable of leveraging digital skills and modern technological solutions. Keeping Pace with Technological Advancement: Integrating Artificial Intelligence applications and advanced intelligent systems into various professional pathways. Enhancing Competitiveness: Enabling trainees to access high-quality employment opportunities locally and internationally while supporting the freelancing ecosystem. Strategic Partnerships: Strengthening collaboration with global technology leaders to enrich the educational and training process and transfer cutting-edge knowledge.

title: DEPI - Depi
text: DEPI Core Program The Core DEPI Program includes 7 specialized training tracks with 31 job profiles, covering a broad range of the most in-demand digital fields in today's labor market, including Software Development, Data Analytics, Management & Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Infrastructure & Cybersecurity, Digital Marketing & Digital Arts, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, and Digital Game Creation.

title: DEPI - Depi Industry
text: Industry DEPI Program The Industry DEPI Program includes 6 specialized training tracks developed in collaboration with industry partners to equip trainees with practical skills and hands-on expertise required in priority technology sectors, enhancing their readiness to join the labor market and compete in future digital careers. Targeted Technology Domains and Emerging Specializations The initiative covers a range of advanced specializations and smart applications aligned with future labor market demands across multiple sectors, including: AI Agent Applications for Teachers and Education Professionals. Applied Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Agents for Legal Professionals. Oracle Fusion Financials (FI) Consulting. AI-Assisted Software Development. Marketing Automation and Artificial Intelligence. AI-Powered Advanced Healthcare Service Solutions. Key Features and Advantages of the Initiative Fully Funded Scholarship: The program is fully funded by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology for Egyptian students and graduates from Egyptian universities and higher institutes residing within the Arab Republic of Egypt. Global and Regional Partnerships: The initiative is implemented in collaboration with leading global technology companies and prominent regional and local organizations, ensuring high-quality training and internationally recognized certifications. Practical and Applied Learning: The scholarship includes hands-on workshops and capstone projects that simulate real work environments while enhancing both technical and interpersonal skills. Flexibility and Continuous Alignment with Market Needs: Programs are continuously updated to align with the rapidly evolving labor market and directly address the needs of students and graduates.

title: DEPI - AI & Data Science - Overview
text:
Overview: Training in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science forms a core pillar in preparing participants for careers in the modern technology sector. These fields focus on leveraging data and applying advanced analytical techniques to identify patterns and generate predictive insights. Artificial Intelligence (AI) focuses on building systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence, including key areas such as Machine Learning, Neural Networks, and Natural Language Processing (NLP). Data Science focuses on extracting value from data to support decision-making. It includes data cleaning, statistical analysis, machine learning techniques, and predictive modelling, with applications in market analysis, behavioural analysis, and operational performance optimisation. Training is delivered through courses and hands-on projects in machine learning and data analysis, enabling participants to acquire practical, job-ready skills aligned with current market needs.
Main Objective: To prepare applicants for freelancing and equip them with the digital skills required in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. This training enables participants to: Develop technical skills: Build a strong foundation in AI and Data Science, including machine learning, data analysis, neural networks, and related advanced technologies. Deliver practical projects: Apply acquired knowledge through real-world projects, strengthening problem-solving and innovation capabilities. Prepare for the labour market: Gain in-demand skills that support entry into emerging technology fields, whether as freelancers or within technology companies.
Who is this track for?: This track is designed for individuals seeking entry into modern technology fields, including: Recent graduates: Individuals seeking to start careers in technology and acquire the skills required for the labour market. Technical professionals: Individuals with basic technical backgrounds in programming or data analysis who wish to specialise further in advanced technology domains. University students: Students in relevant technical disciplines seeking to strengthen their practical experience before graduation. Freelancers: Individuals aiming to expand their services by integrating advanced technologies such as AI into their offerings.
Learning Outcomes: Participants will gain: Advanced technical competencies in machine learning, neural networks, data analysis, and related AI and data science tools. The ability to apply theoretical knowledge in real-world projects. Data analysis skills, including cleaning, processing, and extracting insights using statistical and analytical methods. Decision-making capabilities based on data-driven insights. Creativity and innovation in developing AI-based solutions. Communication and teamwork skills in technical environments.
Upon Completion: Participants will be able to: Design and develop machine learning models for classification, prediction, and clustering tasks. Apply neural network techniques to solve deep learning and classification problems. Develop practical applications in predictive analytics and machine learning-based solutions. Contribute to technical project management within team environments. Use data analysis to improve operational performance and support strategic decision-making. Engage in continuous innovation and development of digital solutions.
Delivery Approach: Training is delivered by specialised training providers under the supervision of the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology. It includes live online sessions and in-person training sessions delivered by certified instructors. The Initiative adopts a learning-by-doing approach , enabling participants to learn through practical engagement, supported by structured guidance and continuous feedback.

title: DEPI - Infrastructure & Security - Overview
text:
Overview: With the increasing reliance on digital services in daily life—such as online banking, e-commerce, and social media—personal and institutional data has become more exposed to cyber threats. Attackers now use advanced techniques to bypass traditional security controls, making cybersecurity a critical and high-demand field. This track covers the technologies and frameworks required to secure computer systems, data, and networks against cyberattacks.
Main Objective: To develop the workforce required to protect Egypt against cyber threats, while also supplying local, regional, and global labour markets with qualified professionals capable of operating and securing computer systems and networks.
Who is this track for?: This track is designed for students in: Computer Science and Information Systems Artificial Intelligence Computer Engineering Telecommunications Engineering Electronics Engineering
Learning Outcomes: Upon completion, participants will be able to: Acquire the technical knowledge and skills required to secure and defend computer systems and networks. Identify, analyse, and respond to cybersecurity incidents. Plan, implement, and monitor cybersecurity frameworks to protect digital assets.
Delivery Approach: Training is delivered by specialised providers under the supervision of the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology through a combination of live online sessions and in-person training, guided by certified instructors. The programme follows a learning-by-doing model , integrating practical engagement with structured guidance and continuous feedback.

title: DEPI - Management & ERP - Overview
text:
Overview: Training is delivered through interactive online sessions and in-person training conducted by certified instructors under the supervision of the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology. The learning model is based on applied training, enabling participants to gain practical experience through guided instruction. The main objective of this track is to develop skills in enterprise resource planning systems used in business management.
Who is this track for?: Graduates of commerce and business administration faculties across all specialisations. Graduates from other disciplines seeking to develop digital transformation and administrative skills relevant to the labour market.
Learning Outcomes: Upon completion, participants will be able to work in: Financial management Human resources management Supply chain and procurement management
Delivery Approach: Training is delivered through live online sessions and in-person sessions under the supervision of certified instructors, following a learning-by-doing methodology supported by continuous feedback.

title: DEPI - Digital Arts - Overview
text:
Overview: In a rapidly evolving business environment, adapting to digital transformation has become essential. One of the most significant developments is the growing importance of creative digital marketing and digital arts. This track equips participants with the skills and knowledge required to succeed in digital marketing and digital arts. It combines theoretical foundations with practical application across industry-standard tools and technologies.
Learning Outcomes: Master advanced skills in digital design and production across: Master the latest design skills and digital arts production across six integrated fields: UI/UX, digital marketing, video production, motion graphics, graphic design, and 3D & VR. UI/UX digital marketing video production motion graphics AI in Digital Arts
Delivery Approach: Training is delivered by specialised providers under the supervision of the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology through practical, project-based learning in interactive sessions and workshops.

title: DEPI - Software Development - Overview
text:
Overview: This track equips participants with the knowledge and skills required to develop high-quality software applications using modern programming tools and technologies. It covers full-stack web development using React, cross-platform mobile development using Flutter, blockchain-based application development using Go, and low-code/no-code platforms for rapid application development. It also includes software testing, DevOps practices, and systems analysis and design, while strengthening teamwork and project management skills.
Who is this track for?: This track is designed for students from engineering, computer science, and other disciplines who wish to develop strong software development capabilities and gain exposure to modern technologies and industry practices.
Learning Outcomes: Upon completion, participants will be able to: Develop web interfaces using React. Build full-stack web applications using .NET technologies. Develop cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter. Perform software testing using manual and automated methods. Apply DevOps practices for integration and deployment. Understand blockchain fundamentals and develop decentralised applications using Go. Use low-code and no-code platforms to build efficient digital solutions.
Delivery Approach: Training is delivered through live online sessions and in-person instruction by certified trainers under the supervision of the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, following a learning-by-doing methodology.

title: DEPI - Data Analytics - Overview
text:
Overview: This track equips participants with the skills required for data analysis, a core requirement across multiple industries. Data analysts support decision-making by interpreting organisational data. Participants are trained using modern tools and techniques aligned with current labour market demands.
Who is this track for?: Designed for students and graduates from engineering, business, and other disciplines.
Learning Outcomes: Participants will be able to: Use data analysis tools to generate reports and insights. Extract, clean, and prepare data from multiple sources. Apply descriptive analysis techniques. Build interactive dashboards to support decision-making. Use data visualisation techniques to communicate insights effectively.

title: DEPI - Digital Game Creation - Overview
text:
Overview: The gaming industry is one of the fastest-growing digital sectors globally, combining technology, creativity, and interactive content to deliver immersive user experiences. This track prepares a new generation of game designers and developers capable of building modern interactive gaming experiences. It is divided into two specialisations: Game Designer and Game Developer , where both roles collaborate to produce industry-standard game experiences. The programme integrates theoretical foundations with hands-on training using industry tools and real production workflows.
Who is this track for?: Designed for students and graduates interested in gaming, interactive media, programming, and 3D design, including beginners and those seeking to enhance their skills in modern production environments.
Learning Outcomes: Upon completion, participants will be able to: Understand modern game production pipelines. Design and develop 2D and 3D games using professional tools. Create interactive environments and basic virtual reality assets. Develop gameplay systems, controls, and user interfaces. Optimise performance across multiple platforms, especially mobile. Collaborate within multidisciplinary production teams. Produce portfolio-ready game projects.
Delivery Approach: Training is delivered through practical, project-based learning, including live sessions, workshops, and collaborative production projects under expert supervision. This track is based on a learning-by-doing methodology , where participants develop playable games and real interactive experiences under the supervision of specialised instructors, enabling them to gain practical production experience aligned with modern game development workflows.

text: Start Date Start Date: July 17, 2026.

title: DEPI - Language of Instruction
text: Language of Instruction Language of Instruction: English.

title: DEPI - Program Duration
text: Program Duration Program Duration: Six months, comprising: Four months of technical tracks and training in freelancing skills, life skills, and English language. Two months of career coaching for freelancing.

title: DEPI - Training Schedule
text: Training Schedule Three sessions per week (two online, one in-person) totaling 9 hours per week. An additional 3 hours per week for practical exercises and projects. Attendance at both online and in-person sessions is mandatory.

title: DEPI - Training Modality
text:
Training Modality Hybrid system: 75% online and 25% in-person at specialized training centers. Trainees must have a computer or laptop with a camera, microphone, and stable internet connection, with alternatives available in case of power outages (such as a charged device, SIM card with internet, or alternative location). In-person sessions are scheduled once every two weeks, replacing one virtual session. Dates are announced prior to the start of study. Physical sessions are dependent on the availability of a sufficient number of trainees within the same governorate; otherwise, replaced by a virtual session.
التدريب هجين / مدمج (أونلاين وحضوري - Hybrid: online and in-person)

title: DEPI - Participation and Obligations
text: Participation and Obligations Students consent to the exchange of their data, documents, and academic records between the program administration and participating companies or entities. Students must complete the program in full and meet all requirements in order to obtain the designated certificates. Course registrations assigned by the initiative cannot be modified or deleted. Students must follow the prescribed study plan without alteration. A one-month study break is granted to current students during final exam periods; no break is granted to graduates. Trainees must attend at least 70% of both in-person and online sessions across all areas (technical training, English, soft skills, and freelancing skills). Trainees in freelancing career paths must secure a minimum of three tasks through freelancing platforms, or achieve earnings of at least USD 300, during the technical training period or career coaching phase. Students must comply with all instructions issued by the initiative's management. Students must pass periodic assessments administered throughout the program.

title: DEPI - Certification
text: Certification A certificate of completion, approved by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, is awarded upon: Fulfillment of all training requirements, Successful completion of the assigned project, and Achievement of at least three freelancing tasks through recognized platforms.

title: DEPI Industry - DEPI Industry - Overview
text:
Overview: Training in the field of Applied AI Agents for Teachers and Education Professionals is considered one of the modern learning pathways aimed at transforming the educational process through Artificial Intelligence (AI) and intelligent automation technologies. This field focuses on enabling educators and educational institutions to leverage smart technologies to improve the quality of education, develop educational content, personalize learning experiences, and enhance operational and administrative efficiency. The main objective of this training track is to prepare teachers and education professionals to use Artificial Intelligence technologies and AI Agents in enhancing educational processes and acquiring modern digital skills required in today's educational environments.
Who is this track for?: This track is designed for individuals working in or aspiring to work in education, training, and academic development fields. It targets several groups, including: Teachers and Educators: Professionals seeking to modernize teaching methods and use AI tools to improve learning experiences. Faculty Members and Trainers: Individuals aiming to develop educational content and manage learning processes using modern technologies. Educational Supervisors and Administrators: Professionals interested in improving operational and administrative efficiency through intelligent automation and data analysis. Instructional Designers and Content Developers: Individuals involved in curriculum and educational material development who want to use AI tools to create personalized and interactive content. E-Learning Professionals: Professionals seeking to develop AI-powered digital learning platforms and learning experiences. In summary, this track provides participants with the opportunity to acquire modern skills necessary for transforming educational processes using AI technologies, contributing to professional excellence and innovation in the education sector.
Learning Outcomes: The learning outcomes of this training track include several important practical and knowledge-based skills, including: Using AI Tools in Education: The ability to apply AI applications in content creation, improving learning experiences, and supporting educational processes. Designing Educational AI Agents: Develop intelligent agents that assist in automating educational and administrative tasks effectively. Developing Smart Educational Content: Create lesson plans, educational activities, and interactive assessments using AI-powered tools. Educational Data Analysis: Understand and analyze student and academic performance data to extract insights that improve educational outcomes. Personalization and Enhanced Learning Experiences: Use AI technologies to provide personalized learning experiences that meet diverse student needs. Innovation and Creativity: Develop innovative educational solutions using automation and AI technologies. Communication and Teamwork: Enhance collaboration and communication skills within digital and technology-driven educational environments. Overall, the outcomes of this track help participants effectively utilize modern technologies to improve educational quality and enhance institutional and academic performance.
How to achieve this: Specialized training providers accredited by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology will deliver live online sessions and in-person workshops with full interaction under the supervision of certified and specialized trainers. We believe in a "Learning by Doing" approach that enables participants to learn in an interactive and motivating environment while receiving continuous support and feedback to ensure the best educational and practical outcomes.
specialization: Applied AI Agents for Education and Teaching Professional

title: DEPI Industry - DEPI Industry - Overview
text:
Overview: Training in Applied Artificial Intelligence and AI Agents for Legal Professionals represents one of the modern and rapidly growing fields supporting the digital transformation of legal services. This track focuses on enabling legal professionals to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) and intelligent automation technologies to improve legal workflows, increase productivity, and enhance decision-making processes within legal environments. The primary objective of this training track is to prepare participants to effectively use Artificial Intelligence and AI-powered automation in legal and compliance environments. The program aims to equip learners with modern digital skills required in the evolving legal technology market.
Who is this track for?: This track is designed for individuals interested in combining legal expertise with modern AI technologies, including: Law Graduates: Individuals seeking to build careers in modern digital legal environments and legal technology fields. Lawyers and Legal Consultants: Professionals aiming to improve legal workflows and use AI tools for legal research, drafting, analysis, and client support. Compliance and Legal Operations Professionals: Individuals interested in using intelligent automation to improve compliance monitoring and legal risk management. Freelancers and Independent Professionals: Professionals seeking to provide advanced AI-powered legal services and improve service efficiency for clients. In summary, this track provides participants with the opportunity to develop modern legal and technical skills that are increasingly required in today's digital legal industry.
Learning Outcomes: The learning outcomes include: Use modern AI tools to support daily legal operations and workflows. Conduct legal research and analyze legal documents more efficiently and accurately. Develop AI agents to assist with contract management and legal case handling. Automate repetitive legal processes and improve operational efficiency. Support compliance and legal risk management using AI technologies. Build intelligent legal solutions that improve service quality and reduce operational costs. Work effectively within modern legal and technology-driven environments focused on innovation and digital transformation. Overall, after completing this track, participants will be equipped with the knowledge and practical skills required to apply Artificial Intelligence and AI Agents in legal services, compliance operations, and modern legal technology environments.
How to achieve this: Specialized training providers accredited by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology will deliver live online sessions and interactive practical workshops under the supervision of certified instructors specialized in Artificial Intelligence and Legal Technology. The training follows a "Learning by Doing" approach, where participants engage in hands-on projects and real-world applications that simulate actual legal work environments. Continuous mentoring and feedback are provided to ensure participants gain the practical skills required for today's digital legal market.
specialization: Applied AI Agents for Legal Professional

title: DEPI Industry - DEPI Industry - Overview
text:
Overview: In a world increasingly driven by speed, data, and artificial intelligence, marketing automation has become one of the most important modern trends reshaping the future of digital marketing and business management. Companies no longer rely solely on manually executing marketing campaigns; instead, they leverage intelligent systems and automation to connect tools, analyze data, manage customers, and improve performance with greater efficiency and sustainability. This track is designed to prepare a new generation of marketers capable of building smart, interconnected marketing systems that rely on artificial intelligence and modern automation, by integrating strategy, content creation, data analysis, campaign management, funnel design, and automated workflow development. The track focuses on transforming the trainee from a task executor into a System-Oriented Marketer, capable of designing and managing integrated marketing ecosystems that operate with high efficiency within modern work environments.
Who is this track for?: This track is designed for students, graduates, entrepreneurs, digital marketers, and content creators who wish to develop their skills in modern marketing, automation, artificial intelligence, and building smart marketing systems.
Learning Outcomes: The learning outcomes include: Understand how modern marketing systems work, built on data and automation. Build integrated marketing strategies powered by artificial intelligence. Create and manage digital marketing campaigns based on analysis, measurement, and performance optimization. Design landing pages, funnels, and complete conversion systems. Connect different tools and platforms within automated workflows using tools such as Make.com and n8n. Manage customer data and CRM systems, and build automated follow-up scenarios. Develop smart marketing systems that reduce manual effort and increase operational efficiency and growth. Execute comprehensive practical projects that qualify them to work within companies or as freelancers in the field of Marketing Automation.
How to achieve this: Specialized training providers, in collaboration with the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, deliver a fully integrated practical learning experience based on application and practice within work environments that simulate the real market. The track emphasizes executing real marketing projects and sequences using the latest artificial intelligence and automation tools, under the supervision of specialized instructors. This ensures that trainees acquire modern practical experience aligned with the requirements of today's digital business landscape.
specialization: Advanced Marketing Automation with AI Professional

title: DEPI Industry - DEPI Industry - Overview
text:
Overview: AI-Centric Healthcare Workforce Training prepares healthcare professionals and administrative teams to use artificial intelligence safely and effectively in clinical and operational workflows. The program covers AI systems, structured prompt engineering, medical RAG assistants, APIs and function calling, guardrails, patient communication, model strategy, evaluation, monitoring, and a practical capstone.
Who is this track for?: Doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and allied healthcare professionals Lab, radiology, public health, and clinical operations staff Healthcare administrators and digital transformation teams Professionals interested in safe AI adoption in healthcare
Learning Outcomes: Understand AI systems, LLMs, machine learning, and clinical AI use cases Create structured prompts for clinical documentation and patient communication Build a medical RAG assistant grounded in trusted healthcare documents Use APIs and function calling for tool-connected healthcare workflows Apply guardrails for PHI detection, de-identification, prompt injection defense, and escalation Evaluate and monitor AI systems using benchmarks, quality metrics, and incident workflows
How to achieve this: Specialized training service providers through the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology run live online sessions and physical sessions with full interaction under the guidance of a specialized and certified trainer. The track features hands-on labs, guided exercises, and practical healthcare scenarios designed to build applied expertise. The participants work with both closed and open AI models, APIs, RAG, guardrails, and monitoring tools to ensure safe and effective implementation. The participants should deliver a final capstone project and pass a practical exam, each based on real clinical or operational use cases, allowing participants to demonstrate their skills in authentic healthcare contexts.

title: DEPI Industry - Start Date
text: Start Date July 17, 2026.

title: DEPI Industry - Language of Instruction
text: Language of Instruction English.

title: DEPI Industry - Program Duration
text: Program Duration Four months, comprising: Three months of technical tracks and training in freelancing skills, and life skills. One month of career coaching for freelancing.

title: DEPI Industry - Training Schedule
text: Training Schedule Total hours for the technical training are 81 hours. Total hours for the skills training are 27 hours. Attendance at technical and skills sessions is mandatory.

title: DEPI Industry - Training Modality
text:
Training Modality Hybrid system: 75% online and 25% in-person at specialized training centers. Trainees must have a computer or laptop with a camera, microphone, and stable internet connection, with alternatives available in case of power outages (such as a charged device, SIM card with internet, or alternative location). In-person sessions are scheduled once every two weeks, replacing one virtual session. Dates are announced prior to the start of study. Physical sessions are dependent on the availability of a sufficient number of trainees within the same governorate; otherwise, replaced by a virtual session.
التدريب هجين / مدمج (أونلاين وحضوري - Hybrid: online and in-person)

title: DEPI Industry - Participation and Obligations
text: Participation and Obligations Students consent to the exchange of their data, documents, and academic records between the program administration and participating companies or entities. Students must complete the program in full and meet all requirements in order to obtain the designated certificates. Course registrations assigned by the initiative cannot be modified or deleted. Students must follow the prescribed study plan without alteration. Trainees must attend at least 70% of both in-person and online sessions across all areas (technical training, soft skills, and freelancing skills). Trainees in freelancing career paths must secure a minimum of three tasks through freelancing platforms, or achieve earnings of at least USD 300, during the technical training period or career coaching phase. Students must comply with all instructions issued by the initiative's management. Students must pass periodic assessments administered throughout the program.

title: DEPI Industry - Certification
text: Certification A certificate of completion, approved by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, is awarded upon: Fulfillment of all training requirements, Successful completion of the assigned project, and Achievement of at least three freelancing tasks through recognized platforms.
